privacy.canary_verification: Automated synthetic canary string must have 0 occurrences in logs, bugreports, SQLite WAL, daemon payloads, the artifacts table, or the world-model graph endpoints
privacy.speech_capture: User-initiated foreground service with visible system indicator only; zero raw audio bytes written to disk; RAM ring buffer only

security.sqlite_triggers: Strictly abort UPDATE and DELETE operations on append-only tables

epistemic_ledger.integrity: SHA-256 hash chaining (computeCanonicalEventHash, packages/core/db.ts): hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonicalJsonStringify({event_id, device_id, kind, ts_device, ts_server, schema_ver, payload})); seq is not hashed. Checked by ExocortexDatabase.verifyEventChain()
epistemic_ledger.immutability: BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers RAISE(ABORT)

active_inference_predictive_engine.framework: Discrete Learned Generative Model (Karl Friston Active Inference)

matrices.A: Observation likelihood P(o|s) Dirichlet count table
matrices.B: Transition model P(s'|s,a) Dirichlet count table
matrices.C: Prior preference distribution P(o) (negative surprisal for preferred states)

active_inference_predictive_engine.objective: Minimization of Expected Free Energy G(pi) = Epistemic Value (information gain) + Pragmatic Value (preference realization)
active_inference_predictive_engine.learning: Single-step conjugate Dirichlet updates (alpha <- alpha + 1) with bounded exponential decay forgetting
active_inference_predictive_engine.calibration: Pre-registered baseline comparison against 14-day trailing daypart usage

hot_cognitive_salience.dynamics: Continuous exponential energy decay: w = w0 * exp(-lambda * delta_t); spreading activation across weighted edges

associative_retrieval.fts: SQLite FTS5 Porter stemmer + unicode61 tokenizer
associative_retrieval.vectors: Int8 quantized nomic-embed-text (768 dimensions + 4-byte scale factor = 772 bytes/chunk)
associative_retrieval.index: In-memory contiguous Int8 buffer with brute-force SIMD cosine search

shadow_evaluation.precision_at_surface: Ratio of accepted proposals with Wilson 95% confidence interval lower bound >= 0.90
shadow_evaluation.circuit_breaker: Automatic HTTP 423 lock on actuation if rolling 14-day precision < 0.90

active_git_branches.sovereign_exocortex: main at bc9b139 (world-model graph durability fix, PR #77)

persistent_graph_state.engine: Neo4j 2026.05.0 (apps/neo4j-import/.neo4j, JVM: Android Studio JBR 21, bolt:7687, http:7474). Stopped; being retired per docs/PLAN_WORLD_MODEL_STORE_2026-10-31.md
persistent_graph_state.daemon_graph: Rebuilt in memory from the full ledger at daemon start (PR #77); Neo4j sync is upsert-only and never deletes curated nodes

active_telemetry.source: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (SM-S948U1) -> pieces-android proxy :8787 -> exocortexd :8788

milestone_1_hardware_spike.target: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (SM-S948U1, SoC SM8850)

gates.G1_Integrity: Tamper rejection & valid file acceptance (4/4 rejected, 1/1 accepted)
gates.G3b_Leak: Retained PSS after release <= baseline + 100 MB
gates.G5_Stability: 0 crashes, 0 ANRs, 0 LMKD kills over 200 runs

components: ModelProvisioner (sideload staging, SHA-256 verify, atomic chmod)
TypedTextSummaryQueue (bounded capacity 4, immediate raw text zeroing)

milestone_3_speech_summaries.spec: Foreground mic service, streaming recognizer (evaluating sherpa-onnx vs whisper.cpp), RAM ring buffer only, encrypted speech_session table with biometric KEK

graph_store_transition.goal: Retire Neo4j; serve the world-model graph from an in-memory store behind a GraphStore port, rebuilt from the full ledger at boot
graph_store_transition.escalation: SQLite cache, then LadybugDB, only if a frozen P2 gate fails
graph_store_transition.concurrency_policy: exocortexd daemon is sole RW owner; CLI and tools query via HTTP :8788

counterfactual_error_mining.pipeline: Ledger -> Outbox Tailer -> Read-Only Graph Query -> Error Cluster Detection -> Proposal Event -> Active Inference Learner
counterfactual_error_mining.target_query: MATCH (p:Prediction)-[:IN_CONTEXT]->(c:Context) WHERE p.conf_cal >= tau AND p.resid_z >= z AND p.delta_vs_baseline > 0 RETURN c, count(*), avg(p.surprisal)

views:
CREATE VIEW events_canonical AS
  SELECT e.* FROM events e
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telemetry_tally_members m JOIN telemetry_tally t USING (dedupe_key)
                      WHERE m.seq = e.seq AND m.seq <> t.canonical_seq)
